I use a plugin to redirect all of my browsing to https links.

I'm getting an error at https://voat.co/v/all that I don't get on some of the other pages.

This is the cause (right after your opening html tag):

<head prefix="og: [http://ogp.me/ns#](http://ogp.me/ns#)">
 <meta charset="utf-8" />
 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
 <meta lang="en"/>
 <link rel="http://oexchange.org/spec/0.8/rel/related-target" type="application/xrd+xml" href="http://voat.co/oexchange.xrd" />

There are two http links in that snippet. I weirdly don't get the error in Firefox, even though Firefox is notorious for warning users about http link and image tags in https pages.

I also see that all of the links on that page seem to be going to http://blah.com.

The easiest way to fix this is to make all links begin with // instead of http:// or https://
